// CASE tsx_honest expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}
// CASE tsx_distinct_attr expect=fire
export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    render(await step(item), <Row value={await save(item)} />);
  }
}
// CASE tsx_distinct_child expect=fire
export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    render(await step(item), <Row>{await save(item)}</Row>);
  }
}
